title: Boxcar Nine
pitch: Victor's hijacked load is in a boxcar on Mrs Doran's siding. She wants paying to release it, and Varga's bidding too.

clue_a.label: The boxcar
lines: The seal on nine's been cut and tied back with her wire. Two cases short. She's already helped herself.

clue_b.label: The van
lines: A Varga card on the van seat, a figure on the back. Eight hundred. That's the price she's trying to beat.
